provenance.kind: Project-authored controlled scientific study. All tables are stipulated model observations, not a claim of new experimental or ab-initio results.
provenance.scope: Inference is conditional on the explicit finite model, source identities, units and measurement policy.

statistic: For every unordered pair of distinct plant rows with UNEQUAL positive degrees, take shared_neighbors/min(degree_i,degree_j). Do the same for pollinator columns. The statistic is the arithmetic mean over those eligible row AND column pairs combined; equal-degree pairs and zero-degree denominators are omitted. This explicitly defined proxy is not a claim to match every named NODF implementation.
null_model: Uniform over ALL3x4binary matrices with the EXACT observed row-degree vector and column-degree vector in original identity order. No permuting node labels, independent Bernoulli edges or unequal weighting of graphs. Enumerate the complete finite set. Exact upper tail includes every null statistic>=observed, including the observed matrix and ties within1e-12.
scope: Controlled bipartite community-network geometry. A finite-ensemble tail fraction is conditional on this declared graph model, not a randomized ecological intervention or proof of coadaptation.
